zariadenie.iphoneText: Play on a computer, a tablet or an Android phone — your game in progress will wait for you there.
zariadenie.rankText: Players from the Shot rank up can play on phones. Go through the First Game tutorial on a computer first.
zariadenie.rankText2: You'll make Shot after the tutorial or after your first finished game. Then you can play on an Android phone too.
zariadenie.otocText: The phone table only works sideways. Turn your phone — your game in progress will wait.
zariadenie.dotykText: The game table needs a wide screen and a mouse. Open NA EX! on a computer or on a tablet held sideways — your game in progress will wait for you there.
zariadenie.uzkeText: The window is too narrow for the game table. Make it at least 900 px wide and the game will appear — your game in progress will wait.

stol.tipKraja: Upper hand: the actions of this edge go to whoever has more of their own Citizens, Animals and Elders on this wing (Tools and Cirrhosis don't count); on a tie, the owner of the card next to the location. Now: {kto}.
stol.rovnostTy: tie {a} : {b} → you hold the edge (your card is next to the location) ·
stol.rovnostSuper: tie {a} : {b} → {meno} holds the edge (the opponent's card is next to the location) ·
zhrom.nastroj: Tuck a Tool under a card in the line for {cigarety} or put it into your Heirloom.
zhrom.pasujesOdlozene: You pass to the Booze-up — you get {cigarety}, then {meno} plays alone. You can still undo it for {s} s.
zhrom.nicNevylozis: You can't play anything more. Pass to the Booze-up.
zhrom.nicNevylozisZaPas: You can't play anything more. Pass to the Booze-up — you get {cigarety}.
zhrom.pokyn: Drag a card onto the table or click + at the end of the line, or pass to the Booze-up (a cigarette for every card you didn't play).
zhrom.dalsiaKarta: Another card this turn costs a full shot.
zhrom.pasTip: You stop playing cards until the Booze-up; your opponent plays alone. You get a cigarette for every card you could still have played.
koniec.poznLokalit: Next to each location are its winner's butts for it (brawl, Work, elders, Thrashing, Bailiff). The total below also counts the loser of every brawl, the cash-in and Cirrhosis.
koniec.vykupneRiadok: Cash-in: a full shot is {zaPoldeci} butt, every {zaCigarety} cigarettes 1 butt — you {ja}, {meno} {su}.
koniec.vazni: Prisoners after the finale (archived game up to v10): you +{ja}, {meno} +{su}.
koniec.cirhozy: Unconfessed Cirrhosis at the end: {spaky} each (hand and both piles) — you ×{ja}, {meno} ×{su}.
ucet.zrejucaBezPravaUvod: The test version of the game is for players with permission — the admin grants it (by default Bottle, administrators and AI playtesters).
ucet.vitajSpatUvod: Log in and carry on where you stopped.
ucet.zrejucaUvod: Rules and cards still being tried out. Players with permission play it; you log in with the same account as in Distilled.
ucet.oficialna: Want to play the official game? {odkaz}.
ucet.novyUcetUvod: You need an account to play. Rules and cards are open to everyone.
ucet.loginPomoc: 3 – 32 characters without accents. Only used to log in.
ucet.hernemenoPomoc: This is what your opponent sees. You can change it any time.
ucet.hernemenoPriklad: e.g. Dave from the far end of the village
profil.jazykPomoc: Language of the website and the game. Cards and rules are being translated step by step — whatever isn't translated yet stays in Slovak. Melichar's quips stay in Slovak, with subtitles.
bot.nadpis: Who are you sitting down with?
bot.nahodny: If you don't pick anyone, you get a random opponent.
bot.igor: Attacker — fights for every location and deals as much hard damage as he can.
bot.rudo: Hoarder — piles up cigarettes, Visions and shots, survives the first rounds and throws his cards in at the finale.
bot.bozena: Believer — plays Faith and Superstitions and scores with the elders through rumours, even when she loses the brawl.
bot.darina: Spoiler — saddles her opponent with Debts and liver damage, even through NA EX.
vstup.naucSa: Learn to play with Master Melichar — three parts, about 35 minutes in all
vstup.pravidlaText: You play the first round against the Regular and Melichar tells you at the table what to do and why. The rules will wait here for when you want to look something up.
vstup.rozohrana: Master Melichar is waiting at the table — you're in the middle of part {cast} ({nazov}).
vstup.dalsia: You've done part {hotova}. Part {cast}: {nazov}, about {minuty} minutes — it starts where you stopped.
vstup.pripravujeme: You've done part {hotova}. Part {cast} ({nazov}) is on its way.
vstup.hotova: You've done the tutorial. If you want to go over the rules again, play it again.
vstup.prvaCast: Part 1: Master Melichar walks you through the first round against the Regular — location, Market, Assembly, a Booze-up with your first NA EX!, a brawl and the elders. The answer to NA EX and other dirty tricks come in part 2. It doesn't count towards your stats.
vstup.radsejCitas: Rather read? The {odkaz} are here as a handbook.
vstup.najprvText: I'm Master Melichar. In three short parts I'll teach you to play NA EX! — each takes about ten minutes and can be paused. You'll play against the Regular and I'll tell you what to do and why.
vstup.kedykolvek: You'll find the tutorial at the top of the Play page any time.
